summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PT Nusa Pratama Solution landing page & admin CMS. Backend: 26 pytest cases (auth/login, lockout, /auth/me, change-password with revert, GET /api/content, PUT /api/services/{key} with revert, PUT /api/settings with revert, POST /api/upload + GET /api/files/{id}, negative/auth cases) -> 25 pass, 1 fail (login does not set httpOnly cookie, playbook deviation). Frontend: landing default ID, EN/ID toggle across sections, WhatsApp float button, all 4 service modals (desc per language, gallery, customers, close), admin login (invalid + valid), dashboard tabs, service edit save + persistence verified via GET /api/content (reverted), NIB editor, gallery upload via Emergent Object Storage, logout, protected-route redirect, mobile viewport. All frontend flows pass; only minor UX/perf issues found. All test data reverted to seed values.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout key is f"{request.client.host}:{email}" but request.client.host is the ingress proxy pod IP which rotates across replicas (observed 10.79.139.10 and .11). Counter is split, so lockout triggered only on the 8th attempt in a 12-attempt run instead of the 6th. Use X-Forwarded-For first hop (or key on email only) so the 5-attempt threshold is enforced.

No httpOnly Secure cookie set on login (frontend stores JWT in localStorage under np_token) even though get_current_admin reads request.cookies['access_token']. Playbook expects httpOnly cookie auth; localStorage tokens are XSS-exposed. Also no logout endpoint to clear cookie.
allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS default '*' is an invalid/ignored combination in browsers; set explicit origins if cookie auth is adopted.
seed() only inserts admin when missing; it never updates password_hash if ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env changes (playbook expects idempotent update). Same for DEFAULT_SERVICES content changes.
No delete endpoint and no storage cleanup: removing a photo from a service gallery leaves the object and db.files record orphaned (is_deleted never set).
Changing the password does not invalidate previously issued JWTs (no token version/blacklist); old 24h tokens keep working.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the modal (only backdrop click / X button). Also no body scroll-lock or focus trap while modal is open.
Mobile menu stays open after using language-toggle-mobile and remains rendered behind the service modal; should auto-close after toggle/navigation.

issues: Gallery photos are ~1MB JPEGs served from static.prod-images CDN with no loading=lazy, width/height or placeholder, so the modal shows blank grey boxes for ~1-2s before images paint (verified naturalWidth=0 immediately after open, 1264 after load).
7px horizontal overflow on mobile (document.scrollWidth exceeds viewport) - some full-bleed section causes a slight sideways scroll.

action_items: Fix lockout identifier to use the real client IP (X-Forwarded-For) or email-only key so lockout fires exactly after 5 failed attempts.

Decide auth transport: either set httpOnly Secure SameSite cookie on login (+ /auth/logout) with explicit CORS origins, or remove the unused cookie branch in get_current_admin and document localStorage choice.
Make seed() idempotent: update admin password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Add loading=lazy + fixed aspect placeholder (or smaller/optimized images) for service gallery photos.
Close modal on Escape and lock body scroll; auto-close mobile menu after language toggle.
Add file delete/cleanup when a gallery photo is removed (mark db.files.is_deleted / delete object).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login lockout keyed on proxy IP is ineffective behind ingress - security control effectively weakened.
Lockout record is only cleared on successful login or after expiry check; no TTL index on login_attempts, collection grows unbounded.
PUT /api/services accepts arbitrary strings for gallery URLs with no validation (an admin-only surface, but stored values are rendered directly as img src).
ServiceUpdate customers split by newline in UI can persist empty strings (blank lines) - trim/filter empties server-side.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (2 minor UX issues)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed changes. Temporary edits to hvac + catering services, settings.nib_image_url and admin password were all reverted and re-verified. Test uploads created 2 small PNG objects in Emergent Object Storage plus db.files records (TEST_qa.png) - harmless orphans. Dummy lockout emails written to db.login_attempts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). The only failing test is TestAuth::test_login_sets_httponly_cookie (intentional - documents playbook deviation). The lockout test tolerates >5 attempts because of proxy-IP splitting; always use dummy emails for lockout tests so admin login stays usable. Frontend flows (landing, language toggle, service modals, admin login/dashboard/upload/logout) all verified working on 2026-08-28.
rca_of_the_issue: Lockout ineffectiveness RCA: identifier = request.client.host + email; behind the Kubernetes ingress request.client.host is the proxy pod IP and requests round-robin across >=2 pods, so each pod IP accumulates a separate counter (observed counts 2 and 5 for the same email). Fix: derive client IP from X-Forwarded-For (first entry) or drop the IP from the key.
